name: Belgrave Square
heritage: Grade II listed park and garden
text: Belgrave Square is a large 19th-century garden square in London. It is the centrepiece of Belgravia, and its architecture resembles the original scheme of property contractor Thomas Cubitt who engaged George Basevi for all of the terraces for the 2nd Earl Grosvenor, later the 1st Marquess of Westminster, in the 1820s. Most of the houses were occupied by 1840.

depictions.name: Belgrave Square
depictions.text: Belgrave Square is one of the grandest and largest 19th-century squares in London, United Kingdom.
